title: As a senior game developer I have started a side project to get involved with Claude Code better in my free time and here is the first preview of Edenfall, a colony builder and simulation game inspired by RimWorld and Survive the Aftermath
author: fesener

comments.author: fesener
comments.body:
here is a small gameplay video as well: https://x.com/edenfallgame_/status/2051041468387582269?s=46&t=XaqEQ2AWxKK5kMuGYbtgGQ 

Be warned tho, It is still pretty rough.

comments.author: LeafyWolf
comments.body: Very nice!  I'm building a world simulator right now, myself, so very interesting to see how yours goes.

comments.author: Chaibi_Alaa
comments.body: is that a 2d fixed angle or 3d ? if 2d did you use some IA to generate the map and props correctly ?

replies.author: count023
replies.body: I keep telling people these days, you dont need to anymore, just read up on software design patterns and you're good. you just tell the AI how to design the game around those patterns and check when it's trying to cut corners, let it do all the hard syntax shit

replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body: You really don't need to know how to code to use Claude and make a game. I have a project I'm planning to show soon that I wouldn't ever imagine getting this far, I have done no coding and worked through all of it with Claude. Just use an engine or editor with alot of documentation and you'll be surprised what kind of systems you can build

replies.author: SquirrelTomahawk
replies.body: Oh yeah I'm building one right now it looks terrible but I'm still pushing through, building tools to help

comments.author: hammackj
comments.body: That ui looks nice. What library are you using?

replies.author: fesener
replies.body: UI is complete pain in the ass (no surprise there tbh), I have tried both Codex and CC, this is the result of both mixed

replies.author: fesener
replies.body: Mix of Meshy, ChatGPT and non-ui asset packs
